integer_local.fitting: Eight single-content proposals for every slot; IntegerLocalResponse selects its fixed internal alternatives using only that proposal's source and training mask
integer_local.held_selection: Held h excludes proposal source h and scoring content h during selection on the other seven; h is scored only after choosing that fold's proposal
integer_local.proposal_ties: Exact mean-loss ties select the lowest proposal-source index
integer_local.adoption: Require more than 1e-10 improvement in mean held MSE8; ties and incomplete default evidence retain the complete default operator
integer_local.full_selection: Select the new proposal by mean MSE8 over all eight supports after the held comparison
integer_local.information_boundary: Only anonymous support pairs and saved support-derived defaults/held losses; no query, labels, recipe, candidate histories, or AI calls
integer_local.validation_scope: Held losses select the candidate family and are not independent validation; the final candidate was motivated by development diagnosis
